# SlotFill

> SlotFill is a deterministic no-show recovery service for appointment businesses such as clinics, salons and home services. By TechAurah.

Key facts:
- License: MIT. Runtime: Python 3.11+, standard library plus PyYAML.
- It is not a booking system and contains no LLM: every behaviour is deterministic, testable state-machine logic.
- Safety property: a fresh install sends nothing. The default notifier is a dry-run log; real messages go out only as email through a configured SMTP server, and every send and offer is written to a local SQLite log.
- Calendar status, honestly: the bundled fake calendar is fully working and runs the demo and tests offline. The Google Calendar adapter validates configuration only in v0.1, with the live API wiring contract documented in docs/setup.md. CalDAV is a documented adapter contract, not yet implemented.
- Current version: 0.1.0.

## Documentation

- [README](https://github.com/techaurah/slotfill): Full overview, quickstart, comparison and FAQ
- [Setup](https://github.com/techaurah/slotfill/blob/main/docs/setup.md): Configuration reference, scheduling cycles, and the honest adapter status table including the Google Calendar wiring contract
- [Vertical packs](https://github.com/techaurah/slotfill/blob/main/docs/packs.md): Pack format for reminder offsets, templates and reply keywords, plus the waitlist CSV format
- [Notifiers](https://github.com/techaurah/slotfill/blob/main/docs/notifiers.md): Notifier contracts for email, and the documented WhatsApp and SMS adapter contracts
- [Changelog](https://github.com/techaurah/slotfill/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): What each version added

## Examples

- [Demo walkthrough](https://github.com/techaurah/slotfill/blob/main/examples/demo.md): The full cycle, reminders, cancellation, waitlist offers, first accept wins, write-back, annotated and runnable with zero credentials via `slotfill demo`
- [Example waitlist](https://github.com/techaurah/slotfill/blob/main/examples/waitlist.csv): The CSV waitlist format, including a non-matching entry that is correctly never offered a slot
- [Vertical packs](https://github.com/techaurah/slotfill/tree/main/packs): The clinic, salon and home-services data packs that drive reminders and templates

## Use it

- [Install](https://github.com/techaurah/slotfill): Clone the repository, then `python -m pip install -e .` and run `slotfill demo`. Python 3.11 or newer is the only prerequisite.
- [Releases](https://github.com/techaurah/slotfill/releases): Version history and downloads

## Optional

- [Contributing](https://github.com/techaurah/slotfill/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): How to contribute; the easiest first contribution is a vertical pack, one YAML data file and no code
